description: CMS Medicare Part D prescriber rows (by provider and drug): prescriber NPI, name, specialty, state, drug name, claims, 30-day fills and total drug cost. Filter by 10-digit NPI, or by generic drug name with an optional state. Up to 20 rows per call. Related tools on this server, for a different need: health_physician_compare_cms when you need CMS Medicare Doctors and Clinicians file: clinician NPI; health_hospitallink_cms_ratings when you need CMS Hospital General Information: hospital name, city. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
